decision.rationale: Bind the final local release profile to the effective BM25 retriever measured in fresh factual confirmation 001, the immutable Luna H+E1 autonomy result 024, and the fresh multi-concept result 025. The profile correction removes the prior Qwen-versus-BM25 manifest mismatch without changing the effective local retrieval implementation. Exact local HTTPS qualification remains required before tagging.
limitations: This is a provenance and exact-configuration binding, not a new autonomy experiment.

Fresh factual confirmation 001 validly failed its absolute quality gates: BM25 plus the dominance gate reached 63.25% fully grounded success and 96.0% boundary accuracy, with zero severe unsupported releases.
Jina v5 visual confirmation 002 was dropped; the bound release uses text/OCR fallback and makes no representative visual-capability claim.
Public synthetic sources and learners only; no real-professor fidelity, real-student usability, or real-learning-improvement claim.
